orchid.name: Orchid's Quiet Resolve
orchid.line: We watch the winds, awaiting the tide of conflict.

rhino.name: Rhino's River Guard
rhino.line: Hold the west crossing, strike fast on enemy mail.

tiger.name: Tiger General's Watch
tiger.line: Hold the West Ford. Hunt enemy riders on the roads.
